+"""Inkling decoder layer modules (tensor-parallel aware, sequence-first [T, B, H]).
+
+Tensor parallelism: q/k/v/r projections are column-parallel (split by head),
+the attention output projection is row-parallel; the k/v short convolutions
+are split with their channels. Everything that acts on the full hidden state
+(norms, hidden-size short convolutions, router, routed and shared experts) is
+replicated and computed redundantly on every TP rank, so its gradients agree
+across ranks without extra reduction. The two small parameters shared by all
+heads (q/k norm weights, relative-bias profile bank) pass through
+``copy_to_tensor_model_parallel_region`` so their gradient is summed over the
+heads of every rank.

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""
+Native, bridge-free HuggingFace -> Megatron-Core converter for Inkling
+(``thinkingmachines/Inkling``, HF ``model_type: inkling_mm_model``).
+
+Only the text backbone (``model.llm.*``) is mapped; the released audio / vision
+encoder tensors and the MTP head (``model.audio.*``, ``model.visual.*``,
+``model.mtp*``) are not part of the Megatron text model and are explicitly
+ignored (consumed with a logged count).
+
+The Megatron model is Primus's own ``InklingModel``
+(``primus/backends/megatron/core/models/inkling``), built by :func:`build_model`.
+
+Mapping (HF released name -> mcore name, per layer ``L``):
+
+==============================================  ==============================================
+``model.llm.embed.weight``                      ``embedding.word_embeddings.weight`` (padded)
+``model.llm.embed_norm.weight``                 ``embedding.embed_norm.weight``
+``model.llm.norm.weight``                       ``decoder.final_layernorm.weight``
+``model.llm.unembed.weight``                    ``output_layer.weight`` (padded)
+``layers.L.attn_norm.weight``                   ``decoder.layers.L.input_layernorm.weight``
+``layers.L.mlp_norm.weight``                    ``decoder.layers.L.pre_mlp_layernorm.weight``
+``layers.L.attn_sconv.weight``                  ``decoder.layers.L.attn_sconv.weight``
+``layers.L.mlp_sconv.weight``                   ``decoder.layers.L.mlp_sconv.weight``
+``layers.L.attn.wq_du/wk_dv/wv_dv/wr_du``       ``self_attention.linear_q/k/v/r.weight``
+``layers.L.attn.wo_ud``                         ``self_attention.linear_proj.weight``
+``layers.L.attn.q_norm/k_norm``                 ``self_attention.q_norm_weight/k_norm_weight``
+``layers.L.attn.k_sconv/v_sconv``               ``self_attention.k_sconv/v_sconv.weight``
+``layers.L.attn.rel_logits_proj.proj``          ``self_attention.rel_proj``
+``layers.L.mlp.gate.weight/bias/global_scale``  ``mlp.router_weight/router_expert_bias/router_global_scale``
+``layers.L.mlp.experts.w13_weight``             ``mlp.experts_fc1`` (de-interleaved: gate rows, then up)
+``layers.L.mlp.experts.w2_weight``              ``mlp.experts_fc2``
+``layers.L.mlp.shared_experts.shared_w13``      ``mlp.shared_fc1`` (de-interleaved like w13)
+``layers.L.mlp.shared_experts.shared_w2``       ``mlp.shared_fc2``
+==============================================  ==============================================
+
+The released ``w13`` tensors store gate and up rows interleaved
+(row ``2i`` = gate_i, row ``2i+1`` = up_i); transformers' ``Interleave(dim=1)``
+conversion op de-interleaves them, which is reproduced here.
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.checkpoint import native_convert_common as common
+
+LLM = "model.llm."
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# HF config.json -> Megatron args
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _text_config(cfg):
+    return cfg.get("text_config", cfg)
+
+
+def derive_megatron_fields(cfg):
+    """Translate an Inkling HF config dict (top-level or text_config) into Megatron arg values."""
+    t = _text_config(cfg)
+    local_ids = list(t.get("local_layer_ids", list(range(0, t["num_hidden_layers"], 2))))
+    period = 2
+    assert local_ids == list(range(0, t["num_hidden_layers"], period)), (
+        f"Inkling converter expects local layers at every {period}nd layer from 0, got {local_ids}")
+    assert t.get("swa_head_dim", t["head_dim"]) == t["head_dim"]
+    assert t.get("swa_num_attention_heads", t["num_attention_heads"]) == t["num_attention_heads"]
+    assert t.get("dense_mlp_idx", 0) == 0, "Inkling converter supports all-MoE layers only"
+    assert t.get("use_sconv", True) and t.get("use_embed_norm", True)
+    assert t.get("gate_activation", "sigmoid") == "sigmoid" and t.get("norm_after_topk", True)
+    assert t.get("final_logit_softcapping") is None
+    moe_ffn = t.get("moe_intermediate_size", t["intermediate_size"])
+    return dict(
+        hidden_size=t["hidden_size"],
+        num_attention_heads=t["num_attention_heads"],
+        num_layers=t["num_hidden_layers"],
+        max_position_embeddings=4096,
+        norm_epsilon=t.get("rms_norm_eps", 1e-6),
+        rotary_base=10000,
+        untie_embeddings_and_output_weights=True,
+        ffn_hidden_size=moe_ffn,
+        num_query_groups=t["num_key_value_heads"],
+        kv_channels=t["head_dim"],
+        add_qkv_bias=False,
+        vocab_size=t["vocab_size"],
+        inkling_local_layer_period=period,
+        inkling_sliding_window=t["sliding_window_size"],
+        inkling_swa_num_query_groups=t["swa_num_key_value_heads"],
+        inkling_rel_dim=t["d_rel"],
+        inkling_rel_extent=t["rel_extent"],
+        inkling_sconv_kernel_size=t.get("sconv_kernel_size", 4),
+        inkling_num_routed_experts=t["n_routed_experts"],
+        inkling_moe_router_topk=t["num_experts_per_tok"],
+        inkling_num_shared_experts=t["n_shared_experts"],
+        inkling_route_scale=float(t["route_scale"]),
+        inkling_logits_mup_divisor=float(t.get("logits_mup_width_multiplier", 1.0)),
+        inkling_unpadded_vocab_size=t.get("unpadded_vocab_size"),
+        inkling_log_scaling_n_floor=t.get("log_scaling_n_floor"),
+        inkling_log_scaling_alpha=float(t.get("log_scaling_alpha", 0.1)),
+    )
+
+
+INKLING_KEYS = (
+    "inkling_local_layer_period", "inkling_sliding_window", "inkling_swa_num_query_groups", "inkling_rel_dim",
+    "inkling_rel_extent", "inkling_sconv_kernel_size", "inkling_num_routed_experts", "inkling_moe_router_topk",
+    "inkling_num_shared_experts", "inkling_route_scale", "inkling_logits_mup_divisor",
+    "inkling_unpadded_vocab_size", "inkling_log_scaling_n_floor", "inkling_log_scaling_alpha",
+)
+
+
+def build_margs(cfg_fields, args):
+    import argparse
+
+    from megatron.training.arguments import add_megatron_arguments, validate_args
+
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
+    p = add_megatron_arguments(p)
+    m = p.parse_args([])
+
+    m.model_type = "inkling"
+    m.hidden_size = cfg_fields["hidden_size"]
+    m.num_attention_heads = cfg_fields["num_attention_heads"]
+    m.num_layers = cfg_fields["num_layers"]
+    m.norm_epsilon = cfg_fields["norm_epsilon"]
+    # Megatron's ``--norm-epsilon`` flag stores into ``layernorm_epsilon`` (the field
+    # core_transformer_config_from_args copies); set it, or the RMSNorms keep 1e-5.
+    m.layernorm_epsilon = cfg_fields["norm_epsilon"]
+    m.ffn_hidden_size = cfg_fields["ffn_hidden_size"]
+    m.untie_embeddings_and_output_weights = True
+    m.max_position_embeddings = max(cfg_fields["max_position_embeddings"], args.seq_length)
+    m.seq_length = args.seq_length
+
+    m.group_query_attention = True
+    m.num_query_groups = cfg_fields["num_query_groups"]
+    m.kv_channels = cfg_fields["kv_channels"]
+    m.qk_layernorm = False  # Inkling's per-head q/k norms live inside InklingAttention
+
+    m.normalization = "RMSNorm"
+    m.swiglu = True
+    m.add_bias_linear = False
+    m.add_qkv_bias = False
+    # Inkling has no RoPE; the model never applies a rotary embedding.
+    m.position_embedding_type = "rope"
+    m.rotary_base = cfg_fields["rotary_base"]
+    m.apply_rope_fusion = False
+    m.attention_dropout = 0.0
+    m.hidden_dropout = 0.0
+
+    for k in INKLING_KEYS:
+        setattr(m, k, cfg_fields[k])
+
+    # vocab: the released embedding has 201024 rows (> tokenizer vocab); keep them all.
+    m.vocab_size = None
+    m.padded_vocab_size = cfg_fields["vocab_size"]
+    m.make_vocab_size_divisible_by = args.make_vocab_size_divisible_by
+    m.tokenizer_type = "HuggingFaceTokenizer"
+    m.tokenizer_model = args.hf_dir
+    m.trust_remote_code = False
+
+    m.micro_batch_size = 1
+    m.global_batch_size = 1
+    m.train_iters = 1
+
+    m.tensor_model_parallel_size = args.tensor_parallel_size
+    m.pipeline_model_parallel_size = args.pipeline_parallel_size
+    m.expert_model_parallel_size = args.expert_parallel_size
+    m.expert_tensor_parallel_size = args.tensor_parallel_size
+    m.context_parallel_size = 1
+    m.sequence_parallel = False
+    m.world_size = args.tensor_parallel_size * args.pipeline_parallel_size * args.expert_parallel_size
+    m.rank = 0
+    if args.dtype == "bf16":
+        m.bf16 = True
+        m.params_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    elif args.dtype == "fp16":
+        m.fp16 = True
+        m.params_dtype = torch.float16
+    else:
+        m.params_dtype = torch.float32
+    m.use_cpu_initialization = True
+    m.perform_initialization = False
+    m.transformer_impl = "transformer_engine"
+    m.gradient_accumulation_fusion = False
+    m.async_tensor_model_parallel_allreduce = False
+    m.bias_gelu_fusion = False
+    m.bias_swiglu_fusion = False
+    m.masked_softmax_fusion = False
+    m.bias_dropout_fusion = False
+    m.apply_query_key_layer_scaling = False
+
+    m.save = args.save_dir
+    m.ckpt_format = "torch"
+    m.no_save_optim = True
+    m.no_save_rng = True
+    m.no_load_optim = True
+    m.no_load_rng = True
+    m.save_interval = 1
+    m.async_save = False
+    m.ckpt_assume_constant_structure = False
+    m.iteration = 1
+
+    m = validate_args(m)
+    m.padded_vocab_size = cfg_fields["vocab_size"]
+    m.iteration = 1
+    return m
+
+
+def build_model(margs):
+    """Primus's InklingModel (eval mode), built from ``margs`` via the same builder training uses."""
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_builders import inkling_builder
+
+    model = inkling_builder(margs, True, True)
+    return model.to(margs.params_dtype).eval()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# HF -> mcore weight mapping
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _deinterleave(w, dim):
+    """transformers ``Interleave(dim)``: rows (2i, 2i+1) -> (i, n/2 + i), i.e. gate rows first, then up rows."""
+    shape = list(w.shape)
+    split = shape[:dim] + [shape[dim] // 2, 2] + shape[dim + 1:]
+    return w.reshape(split).transpose(dim, dim + 1).reshape(shape).contiguous()
+
+
+def build_mcore_state_dict(model, store, margs, cfg_fields, log):
+    dtype = margs.params_dtype
+    padded_vocab = model.state_dict()["embedding.word_embeddings.weight"].shape[0]
+    sd = {}
+    consumed = set()
+
+    def get(name):
+        consumed.add(name)
+        return store.get(name, dtype)
+
+    def get_f32(name):
+        consumed.add(name)
+        return store.get(name, torch.float32)
+
+    sd["embedding.word_embeddings.weight"] = common.pad_vocab(get(LLM + "embed.weight"), padded_vocab)
+    sd["embedding.embed_norm.weight"] = get(LLM + "embed_norm.weight")
+    sd["decoder.final_layernorm.weight"] = get(LLM + "norm.weight")
+    sd["output_layer.weight"] = common.pad_vocab(get(LLM + "unembed.weight"), padded_vocab)
+
+    for L in range(margs.num_layers):
+        p = f"decoder.layers.{L}."
+        h = f"{LLM}layers.{L}."
+        sd[p + "input_layernorm.weight"] = get(h + "attn_norm.weight")
+        sd[p + "pre_mlp_layernorm.weight"] = get(h + "mlp_norm.weight")
+        sd[p + "attn_sconv.weight"] = get(h + "attn_sconv.weight")
+        sd[p + "mlp_sconv.weight"] = get(h + "mlp_sconv.weight")
+
+        a = p + "self_attention."
+        sd[a + "linear_q.weight"] = get(h + "attn.wq_du.weight")
+        sd[a + "linear_k.weight"] = get(h + "attn.wk_dv.weight")
+        sd[a + "linear_v.weight"] = get(h + "attn.wv_dv.weight")
+        sd[a + "linear_r.weight"] = get(h + "attn.wr_du.weight")
+        sd[a + "linear_proj.weight"] = get(h + "attn.wo_ud.weight")
+        sd[a + "q_norm_weight"] = get(h + "attn.q_norm.weight")
+        sd[a + "k_norm_weight"] = get(h + "attn.k_norm.weight")
+        sd[a + "k_sconv.weight"] = get(h + "attn.k_sconv.weight")
+        sd[a + "v_sconv.weight"] = get(h + "attn.v_sconv.weight")
+        sd[a + "rel_proj"] = get(h + "attn.rel_logits_proj.proj")
+
+        mm = p + "mlp."
+        sd[mm + "router_weight"] = get(h + "mlp.gate.weight")
+        sd[mm + "router_expert_bias"] = get_f32(h + "mlp.gate.bias")
+        sd[mm + "router_global_scale"] = get(h + "mlp.gate.global_scale").reshape(1)
+        sd[mm + "experts_fc1"] = _deinterleave(get(h + "mlp.experts.w13_weight"), 1)
+        sd[mm + "experts_fc2"] = get(h + "mlp.experts.w2_weight")
+        sd[mm + "shared_fc1"] = _deinterleave(get(h + "mlp.shared_experts.shared_w13_weight"), 1)
+        sd[mm + "shared_fc2"] = get(h + "mlp.shared_experts.shared_w2_weight")
+        log(f"  mapped layer {L:2d} ({'local' if L % cfg_fields['inkling_local_layer_period'] == 0 else 'global'})")
+
+    # Non-text tensors (audio / vision encoders, MTP head): not part of the text model.
+    ignored = sorted(k for k in store.all_keys() if not k.startswith(LLM))
+    consumed.update(ignored)
+    # Layers beyond a reduced num_layers (proxy runs) are intentionally not mapped.
+    skipped = sorted(k for k in store.all_keys() if k.startswith(LLM + "layers.")
+                     and int(k[len(LLM + "layers."):].split(".")[0]) >= margs.num_layers)
+    consumed.update(skipped)
+    log(f"  ignored {len(ignored)} non-text tensors (audio/vision/mtp), {len(skipped)} tensors of unused layers")
+    return sd, consumed
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# In-process entrypoint
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def convert(hf_dir, save_dir, *, dtype="bf16", tensor_parallel_size=1, pipeline_parallel_size=1,
+            expert_parallel_size=1, seq_length=4096, make_vocab_size_divisible_by=128, master_port=29563,
+            log=None):
+    """Convert an Inkling HF checkpoint to a legacy Megatron torch ckpt (single process, CPU)."""
+    if log is None:
+
+        def log(*a):
+            print("[inkling-convert]", *a, flush=True)
+
+    common.ensure_megatron_on_path()
+    common.assert_bridge_free("entry")
+    args = SimpleNamespace(hf_dir=hf_dir, save_dir=save_dir, dtype=dtype, tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
+                           pipeline_parallel_size=pipeline_parallel_size, expert_parallel_size=expert_parallel_size,
+                           seq_length=seq_length, make_vocab_size_divisible_by=make_vocab_size_divisible_by)
+    cfg_fields = derive_megatron_fields(common.read_hf_config(hf_dir))
+    margs = build_margs(cfg_fields, args)
+    margs = common.init_megatron_single_process(margs, master_port, log=log)
+    common.assert_bridge_free("post-init")
+    model = build_model(margs)
+    store = common.SafetensorsStore(hf_dir)
+    sd, consumed = build_mcore_state_dict(model, store, margs, cfg_fields, log)
+    common.load_validate_save(model, sd, consumed, store, margs, save_dir, log)
+    common.assert_bridge_free("post-save")
+    return save_dir

+
+"""Inkling model builder + ``model_provider`` (dispatched from
+``primus/core/utils/import_utils.get_model_provider`` for ``model_type: inkling``)."""
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+from megatron.training import get_args, print_rank_0
+from megatron.training.arguments import core_transformer_config_from_args
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_model import InklingModel
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_transformer_config import (
+    InklingTransformerConfig,
+)

+"""Inkling decoder layer modules (tensor-parallel aware, sequence-first [T, B, H]).
+
+Tensor parallelism: q/k/v/r projections are column-parallel (split by head),
+the attention output projection is row-parallel; the k/v short convolutions
+are split with their channels. Everything that acts on the full hidden state
+(norms, hidden-size short convolutions, router, routed and shared experts) is
+replicated and computed redundantly on every TP rank, so its gradients agree
+across ranks without extra reduction. The two small parameters shared by all
+heads (q/k norm weights, relative-bias profile bank) pass through
+``copy_to_tensor_model_parallel_region`` so their gradient is summed over the
+heads of every rank.
+"""
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+from megatron.core.parallel_state import get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size
+from megatron.core.transformer.module import MegatronModule
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_transformer_config import (
+    InklingTransformerConfig,
+)
+
+
+def _device(config):
+    return torch.device("cpu") if config.use_cpu_initialization else torch.cuda.current_device()
+
+
+def _param(config, *shape, init=None):
+    p = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(*shape, dtype=config.params_dtype, device=_device(config)))
+    if config.perform_initialization:
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            if init is None:
+                p.fill_(1.0)
+            elif init == "zeros":
+                p.zero_()
+            else:
+                init(p)
+    return p
+
+
+def rms_norm(x, weight, eps):
+    """HF InklingRMSNorm: fp32 normalisation, cast back, times the weight."""
+    dtype = x.dtype
+    h = x.float()
+    h = h * torch.rsqrt(h.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    return weight * h.to(dtype)
+
+
+class InklingRMSNorm(MegatronModule):
+    def __init__(self, config, size):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        self.eps = config.layernorm_epsilon
+        self.weight = _param(config, size)
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return rms_norm(x, self.weight, self.eps)
+
+
+class InklingShortConv(MegatronModule):
+    """y = x + depthwise_causal_conv(x) in fp32 over the sequence dim of [T, B, C]."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config, channels, tensor_parallel_split=False):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        k = config.inkling_sconv_kernel_size
+        self.kernel_size = k
+        self.weight = _param(config, channels, 1, k, init=config.init_method)
+        if tensor_parallel_split:
+            tensor_parallel.set_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(self.weight, True, 0, 1)
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        T = x.shape[0]
+        dtype = x.dtype
+        xf = x.float()
+        y = F.conv1d(xf.permute(1, 2, 0), self.weight.float(), padding=self.kernel_size - 1,
+                     groups=xf.shape[-1])[..., :T]
+        return (y.permute(2, 0, 1) + xf).to(dtype)
+
+
+class InklingAttention(MegatronModule):
+    def __init__(self, config: InklingTransformerConfig, layer_number: int):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        tp = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.is_local = layer_number % config.inkling_local_layer_period == 0
+        self.head_dim = config.kv_channels
+        self.num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
+        self.num_kv = config.inkling_swa_num_query_groups if self.is_local else config.num_query_groups
+        assert self.num_heads % tp == 0 and self.num_kv % tp == 0, (
+            f"Inkling attention: heads {self.num_heads} / kv heads {self.num_kv} must divide by TP {tp}")
+        self.heads_local = self.num_heads // tp
+        self.kv_local = self.num_kv // tp
+        self.rel_dim = config.inkling_rel_dim
+        self.window = config.inkling_sliding_window if self.is_local else None
+        self.rel_extent = config.inkling_sliding_window if self.is_local else config.inkling_rel_extent
+        self.scaling = 1.0 / self.head_dim
+        self.eps = config.layernorm_epsilon
+        H = config.hidden_size
+
+        def col(out):
+            return tensor_parallel.ColumnParallelLinear(H, out, config=config, init_method=config.init_method,
+                                                        bias=False, gather_output=False)
+
+        self.linear_q = col(self.num_heads * self.head_dim)
+        self.linear_k = col(self.num_kv * self.head_dim)
+        self.linear_v = col(self.num_kv * self.head_dim)
+        self.linear_r = col(self.num_heads * self.rel_dim)
+        self.linear_proj = tensor_parallel.RowParallelLinear(
+            self.num_heads * self.head_dim, H, config=config, init_method=config.output_layer_init_method,
+            bias=False, input_is_parallel=True, skip_bias_add=True)
+        self.k_sconv = InklingShortConv(config, self.kv_local * self.head_dim, tensor_parallel_split=True)
+        self.v_sconv = InklingShortConv(config, self.kv_local * self.head_dim, tensor_parallel_split=True)
+        self.q_norm_weight = _param(config, self.head_dim)
+        self.k_norm_weight = _param(config, self.head_dim)
+        self.rel_proj = _param(config, self.rel_dim, self.rel_extent, init=config.init_method)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states):
+        T, B, _ = hidden_states.shape
+        q, _ = self.linear_q(hidden_states)
+        k, _ = self.linear_k(hidden_states)
+        v, _ = self.linear_v(hidden_states)
+        r, _ = self.linear_r(hidden_states)
+        k = self.k_sconv(k)
+        v = self.v_sconv(v)
+
+        q_w = tensor_parallel.copy_to_tensor_model_parallel_region(self.q_norm_weight)
+        k_w = tensor_parallel.copy_to_tensor_model_parallel_region(self.k_norm_weight)
+        rel = tensor_parallel.copy_to_tensor_model_parallel_region(self.rel_proj)
+
+        # [T, B, n, d] -> [B, n, T, d]
+        q = rms_norm(q.view(T, B, self.heads_local, self.head_dim), q_w, self.eps).permute(1, 2, 0, 3)
+        k = rms_norm(k.view(T, B, self.kv_local, self.head_dim), k_w, self.eps).permute(1, 2, 0, 3)
+        v = v.view(T, B, self.kv_local, self.head_dim).permute(1, 2, 0, 3)
+        r = r.view(T, B, self.heads_local, self.rel_dim).permute(1, 2, 0, 3)  # [B, n, T, d_rel]
+
+        pos = torch.arange(T, device=hidden_states.device)
+        distance = pos[:, None] - pos[None, :]  # q - k
+        rel_logits = torch.matmul(r, rel)  # [B, n, T, extent]
+        idx = distance.clamp(0, self.rel_extent - 1).expand(B, self.heads_local, T, T)
+        bias = rel_logits.gather(-1, idx)
+        bias = bias.masked_fill((distance < 0) | (distance >= self.rel_extent), 0.0)
+
+        if not self.is_local and self.config.inkling_log_scaling_n_floor is not None:
+            tau = 1.0 + self.config.inkling_log_scaling_alpha * torch.log(
+                ((pos + 1).float() / self.config.inkling_log_scaling_n_floor).clamp(min=1.0))
+            tau = tau.view(1, 1, -1, 1)
+            q = (q.float() * tau).to(q.dtype)
+            bias = (bias.float() * tau).to(bias.dtype)
+
+        rep = self.heads_local // self.kv_local
+        if rep > 1:
+            k = k.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)
+            v = v.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)
+
+        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(2, 3)) * self.scaling + bias
+        allowed = distance >= 0
+        if self.window is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & (distance < self.window)
+        scores = scores.masked_fill(~allowed, float("-inf"))
+        probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(q.dtype)
+        out = torch.matmul(probs, v)  # [B, n, T, d]
+        out = out.permute(2, 0, 1, 3).reshape(T, B, self.heads_local * self.head_dim)
+        out, _ = self.linear_proj(out)
+        return out
+
+
+class InklingMoE(MegatronModule):
+    """Sigmoid top-k router with shared-expert sink, routed experts and shared experts (replicated over TP)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config: InklingTransformerConfig):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        H, I = config.hidden_size, config.ffn_hidden_size
+        self.num_experts = config.inkling_num_routed_experts
+        self.num_shared = config.inkling_num_shared_experts
+        self.topk = config.inkling_moe_router_topk
+        self.route_scale = config.inkling_route_scale
+        self.router_weight = _param(config, self.num_experts + self.num_shared, H, init=config.init_method)
+        self.router_global_scale = _param(config, 1)
+        self.register_buffer("router_expert_bias",
+                             torch.zeros(self.num_experts, dtype=torch.float32, device=_device(config)))
+        # gate rows first, then up rows (HF gate_up_proj layout)
+        self.experts_fc1 = _param(config, self.num_experts, 2 * I, H, init=config.init_method)
+        self.experts_fc2 = _param(config, self.num_experts, H, I, init=config.output_layer_init_method)
+        self.shared_fc1 = _param(config, self.num_shared, 2 * I, H, init=config.init_method)
+        self.shared_fc2 = _param(config, self.num_shared, H, I, init=config.output_layer_init_method)
+
+    def route(self, x):
+        logits = F.linear(x, self.router_weight)
+        n = self.num_shared
+        routed_logits, shared_logits = logits[..., :-n], logits[..., -n:]
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            choice = routed_logits.sigmoid() + self.router_expert_bias.to(logits.dtype)
+            idx = torch.topk(choice, self.topk, dim=-1, sorted=False)[1]
+        top = torch.cat([routed_logits.gather(-1, idx), shared_logits], dim=-1)
+        lp = F.logsigmoid(top)
+        w = torch.exp(lp - torch.logsumexp(lp, dim=-1, keepdim=True))
+        w = w * self.route_scale * self.router_global_scale
+        return w[..., : self.topk], idx, w[..., self.topk:]
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states):
+        shape = hidden_states.shape
+        x = hidden_states.reshape(-1, shape[-1])
+        weights, idx, gammas = self.route(x)
+        out = torch.zeros_like(x)
+        flat_idx = idx.reshape(-1)
+        order = torch.argsort(flat_idx, stable=True)
+        counts = torch.bincount(flat_idx, minlength=self.num_experts).tolist()
+        tok = order // self.topk
+        wsel = weights.reshape(-1)[order]
+        start = 0
+        for e, c in enumerate(counts):
+            if c == 0:
+                continue
+            t = tok[start:start + c]
+            gate, up = F.linear(x[t], self.experts_fc1[e]).chunk(2, dim=-1)
+            h = F.linear(F.silu(gate) * up, self.experts_fc2[e]) * wsel[start:start + c, None]
+            out = out.index_add(0, t, h.to(out.dtype))
+            start += c
+        # shared experts, weighted by their sink gammas
+        xs = x.unsqueeze(0).expand(self.num_shared, -1, -1)
+        gu = torch.bmm(xs, self.shared_fc1.transpose(1, 2))
+        gate, up = gu.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        act = F.silu(gate) * up * gammas.transpose(0, 1).unsqueeze(-1)
+        shared = torch.bmm(act, self.shared_fc2.transpose(1, 2)).float().sum(0).to(x.dtype)
+        return (out + shared).view(shape)
+
+
+class InklingDecoderLayer(MegatronModule):
+    def __init__(self, config: InklingTransformerConfig, layer_number: int):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        self.layer_number = layer_number  # 0-based global index
+        H = config.hidden_size
+        self.input_layernorm = InklingRMSNorm(config, H)
+        self.self_attention = InklingAttention(config, layer_number)
+        self.attn_sconv = InklingShortConv(config, H)
+        self.pre_mlp_layernorm = InklingRMSNorm(config, H)
+        self.mlp = InklingMoE(config)
+        self.mlp_sconv = InklingShortConv(config, H)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, **kwargs):
+        residual = hidden_states
+        h = self.self_attention(self.input_layernorm(hidden_states))
+        hidden_states = residual + self.attn_sconv(h)
+        residual = hidden_states
+        h = self.mlp(self.pre_mlp_layernorm(hidden_states))
+        return residual + self.mlp_sconv(h)

+

+    InklingTransformerConfig,
+)

+class InklingEmbedding(MegatronModule):
+    """Vocab-parallel word embedding followed by an RMSNorm (HF InklingNormedEmbedding)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config, vocab_size):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        self.word_embeddings = tensor_parallel.VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            vocab_size, config.hidden_size, init_method=config.init_method, config=config)
+        self.embed_norm = InklingRMSNorm(config, config.hidden_size)
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids):
+        x = self.word_embeddings(input_ids)  # [B, T, H]
+        x = x.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()  # [T, B, H]
+        return self.embed_norm(x)
+
+
+class InklingDecoder(MegatronModule):
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        self.layers = torch.nn.ModuleList([InklingDecoderLayer(config, i) for i in range(config.num_layers)])
+        self.final_layernorm = InklingRMSNorm(config, config.hidden_size)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states):
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states)
+        return self.final_layernorm(hidden_states)
+
+
+class InklingModel(LanguageModule):
+    """Embedding -> Inkling decoder layers -> final norm -> / mup divisor -> output layer.
+
+    Pipeline parallelism is not supported (single stage)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config: InklingTransformerConfig, vocab_size: int, max_sequence_length: int,
+                 pre_process: bool = True, post_process: bool = True, fp16_lm_cross_entropy: bool = False,
+                 parallel_output: bool = True, share_embeddings_and_output_weights: bool = False,
+                 position_embedding_type: str = "none", pg_collection=None, vp_stage: Optional[int] = None):
+        super().__init__(config=config, pg_collection=pg_collection)
+        assert pre_process and post_process, "Inkling: pipeline parallelism is not supported"
+        assert not share_embeddings_and_output_weights, "Inkling keeps embedding and output layer untied"
+        self.vp_stage = vp_stage
+        self.vocab_size = vocab_size
+        self.max_sequence_length = max_sequence_length
+        self.pre_process = pre_process
+        self.post_process = post_process
+        self.fp16_lm_cross_entropy = fp16_lm_cross_entropy
+        self.parallel_output = parallel_output
+        self.share_embeddings_and_output_weights = False
+        self.position_embedding_type = position_embedding_type  # unused: Inkling has no RoPE
+        self.embedding = InklingEmbedding(config, vocab_size)
+        self.decoder = InklingDecoder(config)
+        self.output_layer = tensor_parallel.ColumnParallelLinear(
+            config.hidden_size, vocab_size, config=config, init_method=config.init_method, bias=False,
+            gather_output=not parallel_output)
+        self.input_tensor = None
+
+    def set_input_tensor(self, input_tensor):
+        if isinstance(input_tensor, (list, tuple)):
+            input_tensor = input_tensor[0]
+        self.input_tensor = input_tensor
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids, position_ids=None, attention_mask=None, labels=None, loss_mask=None,
+                packed_seq_params=None, **kwargs):
+        assert packed_seq_params is None, "Inkling: packed sequences are not supported"
+        hidden = self.embedding(input_ids)
+        hidden = self.decoder(hidden)
+        hidden = hidden / self.config.inkling_logits_mup_divisor
+        logits, _ = self.output_layer(hidden)  # [T, B, V(/tp)]
+        unpadded = self.config.inkling_unpadded_vocab_size
+        if unpadded is not None and unpadded < self.vocab_size:
+            per_rank = logits.shape[-1]
+            start = per_rank * (torch.distributed.get_rank(self.pg_collection.tp) if self.parallel_output else 0)
+            ids = torch.arange(start, start + per_rank, device=logits.device)
+            logits = logits.masked_fill(ids >= unpadded, torch.finfo(logits.dtype).min)
+        if labels is None:
+            return logits.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()  # [B, T, V]
+        return self.compute_language_model_loss(labels, logits)

+
+"""Inkling transformer config.
+
+Extends Megatron's :class:`TransformerConfig` with the fields the Inkling
+modules need and that upstream does not declare. The fields are bound from
+the YAML by ``core_transformer_config_from_args(args, config_class=...)``;
+no argparse registration is needed.
+
+Inkling (HF ``inkling_mm_model`` text backbone) per decoder layer:
+
+* attention without RoPE: q/k RMSNorm per head, depthwise causal short
+  convolutions on k and v, a learned relative-position logit bias
+  (``d_rel`` x ``rel_extent`` profile bank mixed per token and head),
+  scores scaled by ``1 / head_dim``;
+* layers alternate local (sliding window, ``inkling_swa_num_query_groups``
+  KV heads, bias extent = window) and global (``num_query_groups`` KV heads,
+  bias extent ``inkling_rel_extent``);
+* a short convolution on the attention output and on the MLP output;
+* a sigmoid top-k MoE whose router also scores the shared experts
+  ("shared-expert sink"), renormalised over the chosen + shared experts.
+
+``multi_latent_attention`` must stay False: ``core_transformer_config_from_args``
+would otherwise replace this class by ``MLATransformerConfig``.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+__all__ = ["InklingTransformerConfig"]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class InklingTransformerConfig(TransformerConfig):
+    """Inkling-specific fields (defaults: the released Inkling text backbone)."""
+
+    inkling_local_layer_period: int = 2
+    """Layer ``i`` is a local (sliding-window) layer when ``i % period == 0``; the others are global.
+    HF ``local_layer_ids`` [0, 2, 4, ...]."""
+
+    inkling_sliding_window: int = 512
+    """Sliding window of the local layers (a key at distance ``q - k`` in ``[0, window)`` is visible).
+    It is also the relative-bias extent of the local layers."""
+
+    inkling_swa_num_query_groups: int = 4
+    """KV heads of the local layers (the global layers use ``num_query_groups``)."""
+
+    inkling_rel_dim: int = 16
+    """Width of the per-head relative states (HF ``d_rel``)."""
+
+    inkling_rel_extent: int = 1024
+    """Relative-bias extent of the global layers (HF ``rel_extent``)."""
+
+    inkling_sconv_kernel_size: int = 4
+    """Kernel width of the depthwise causal short convolutions."""
+
+    inkling_num_routed_experts: int = 256
+    inkling_moe_router_topk: int = 6
+    inkling_num_shared_experts: int = 2
+    inkling_route_scale: float = 8.0
+
+    inkling_logits_mup_divisor: float = 3.0
+    """The final hidden state is divided by this before the output layer (HF logits_mup_width_multiplier)."""
+
+    inkling_unpadded_vocab_size: Optional[int] = None
+    """When set, logits of ids >= this are masked out (HF unpadded_vocab_size). Left unset for training."""
+
+    inkling_log_scaling_n_floor: Optional[int] = 128000
+    inkling_log_scaling_alpha: float = 0.1
+    """Global layers scale queries and the relative bias by 1 + alpha * log(max(1, (pos + 1) / n_floor))."""
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        super().__post_init__()
+        assert self.inkling_local_layer_period >= 1
+        assert self.num_attention_heads % self.inkling_swa_num_query_groups == 0

+#

+# Built by Primus's own InklingModel (model_type: inkling), see
+# primus/backends/megatron/core/models/inkling/.
+#
+#   8 layers, hidden 768, 8 heads x head_dim 128.
+#   Layers alternate local (sliding window 512, 4 KV heads) and global (2 KV heads).
+#   No RoPE: positions come from a learned relative logit bias (d_rel 16).
+#   Short causal convs (kernel 4) on K/V and on the attention / MLP outputs.
+#   Every layer is MoE: 256 routed experts (top-6, ffn 384) + 2 shared "sink" experts,
+#   sigmoid router with selection bias, route_scale 8.
+#   Untied embeddings, normed embedding, logits divided by the muP multiplier 3.
+#   ~2.2 B total / ~418 M active parameters.
+#
+# position_embedding_type stays "rope" only to keep the Megatron config path valid;
+# InklingModel never applies rotary embeddings (no_rope_freq: 1 marks every layer NoPE).

+norm_epsilon: 1.0e-6

+vocab_size: 201024

+group_query_attention: true
+num_query_groups: 2
+kv_channels: 128
+qk_layernorm: false
+window_size: null
+
+# no RoPE

+rotary_base: 10000
+no_rope_freq: 1
+apply_rope_fusion: false
+

+gradient_accumulation_fusion: false
+sequence_parallel: false
+

+inkling_sliding_window: 512
+inkling_swa_num_query_groups: 4
+inkling_rel_dim: 16

+inkling_num_routed_experts: 256

+inkling_num_shared_experts: 2
+inkling_route_scale: 8.0
+inkling_logits_mup_divisor: 3.0
+inkling_log_scaling_n_floor: 128000
